jrTimetableNote: JR says the published basic timetable omits some extra trains. Check the operator for a selected date; SmartEX booking requires traveler membership. No registration was performed.
plannerNotes: Store ordered city stays and separate transfer dates. Dates are local to each city: Asia/Tokyo, Europe/Rome, Europe/Paris, Europe/London.
Use one-way flight links for city hops; airport pair must be explicit. Different airports and baggage can change total journey time and cost.
Never treat unknown duration as zero or estimate public transport time from straight-line map distance. Keep price/duration/availability null until an authorized live source is integrated.
For rail or ticket sites without verified date-prefill, prompt travelers to reselect dates on the official site.
The site's destination diagrams must use independently sourced data and be labeled as stop order rather than Google-confirmed route geometry.
Plain links currently have no affiliate tracking and earn no commission. No signup, credentials, terms acceptance, or paid API was performed.
